newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ringgit extends gains on further dollar selling.
newsitem.headline: Ringgit extends gains on further dollar selling.

text.p: * Ringgit extends gains on commercial selling of dollar/ringgit
* Dollar/ringgit seen in range trading due to lack of fresh factors
* Ringgit's topside expected to be capped at 2.5000
The ringgit extended gains against the dollar in early Asian trading on followthrough commercial selling of dollar/ringgit, dealers said.
"There's still some commercial selling interest from yesterday," said a dealer with a foreign bank in Kuala Lumpur. "The ringgit is strengthening but nothing really to get excited about."
Dealers said lack of fresh factors would again keep dollar/ringgit movements tight.
They expect some immediate resistance for the ringgit at 2.5030 a dollar with topside likely to be capped at 2.5000.
At 0145 GMT, the ringgit was at 2.5039/49 a dollar against 2.5058/68 at close of Kuala Lumpur on Monday.
